items.question: What is the status of one who does not worship the animal-formed Śivā goddess in solitude?
premises: The verse names an animal-formed Śivā goddess.
It identifies a person who does not worship her.
The worship is to occur in solitude.
items.inference: The verse marks non-worship of the animal-formed Śivā goddess in solitude as a defining failure.
uncertainties: The verse states no explicit consequence or penalty.
Whether nirjane modifies worship or the goddess is contextually inferred.
items.plain_english: He who does not worship the animal-formed Śivā goddess in solitude.
